title: 第1311章 亲临玉京皇都两章合一第1310章 打上灵山两章合一
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: “他们疯了吗？竟然敢跑到这里来撒野？”
佛主脸色阴沉如水。
诸佛也难以置信，脸上感到了一阵火辣辣的疼痛。
刚刚他们在灵山大殿中，还在高谈论阔，言称两尊大佛陀已经将林羽捉拿，即便是不小心打死了，灵山也无恙，通天山的两个疯子也不敢来此撒野，顶多对佛国在外的那些香火之所出手而已。
他们从未想过。
有人敢打上灵山！
但此刻，看着那两道身影，他们的脸瞬间涨成了猪肝色。
打脸，竟然来得如此之快！
而且是先后两次打脸，一次比一次更疼！
佛主胸口微微起伏，怒到了极致，他当机立断的喝到：“通天山的余孽，竟敢不知死活出现在这里，那就别走了，一起催动圣兵，将他们彻底留在这里。”
随着他一声令下。
抖手一甩，便是一个钵盂飞出。
这又是一件圣兵。
不止如此，另外有两尊可怕的老僧手中，也有圣光绽放，催动了另外两件圣兵。
一时之间，加上降魔杵的话，一共动用了四件圣兵了，外加圣道大阵。
只可惜。
他们速度太慢了。
天穹之上，诡异唠老道和李望水已然将诛仙四剑和诛仙图合一了，爆发出了最为恐怖的圣道法则，趁着佛国的三件圣兵还没有复苏的间隙，直接打出了最为恐怖的一击。
诛仙图震动，爆发亿光光芒，令其下的诛仙四剑圣威达到了最恐怖的程度。
四剑合一，宛若开天辟地的无上剑光，重重的斩在了圣道大阵之上。
接着便发出了一声令所有佛国之人恐惧的声音。
“咔嚓！”
伴随着清脆的声音响起，圣道大阵颤抖了两息之后直接炸开了，被诛仙四剑斩穿。
突破了圣道守护大阵后，又与降魔杵重重的碰撞在了一起，圣威浩荡，降魔杵被劈飞了出去，砸入了一座浮空岛上，令其炸开。
同时，四剑余威继续横斩而过，冲向灵山最核心的那座大殿。
连续击穿圣道大阵和降魔杵，四剑的圣威已经被磨灭了许多了，但毁掉一座大殿还是没问题的。
而佛主等人手中的圣兵还没有复苏，根本挡不住这一剑，能够护住四周的其他佛国强者就已经很不容易了。
“轰隆隆！”
没有任何的意外，那座大殿炸开了，佛光四射。
几乎只是须臾之间而已，那座大殿上就被一剑化为了飞灰。
“啊啊啊！”
“通天山的余孽，本座杀了你们！”
伴随着一声滔天的怒吼，五件圣兵已然复苏，爆发出了横压一切的可怕气息。
“哈哈哈，西天的秃驴，本座只不过是来还债的，记住我们说过的话，再敢动林羽一根汗毛，下次定要你整个灵山都倾覆过来。”
李望水张狂的大笑声响起。
“有本事你们灵山天天都让圣兵处于复苏的状态，不然本座还会再来的。”
放下狠话后。
诛仙四剑化作流光，带着两人刹那间消失不见了。
李望水和诡异老道不是鲁莽之人，出其不意打出最强的圣道一击后，直接就跑了。
不然真将灵山深处沉睡的古佛惊醒的话，那可就麻烦了，搞不好会惊动出一尊真正的圣佛。
content_en:
"Are they crazy? How dare they come here and act wild?"
Lord Buddha's face was as gloomy as water.
The Buddhas were also in disbelief and felt a burning pain on their faces.
Just now, they were talking loudly in the Lingshan Hall, saying that the two great Buddhas had captured Lin Yu. Even if they were accidentally killed, Lingshan would be fine. The two lunatics from Tongtian Mountain did not dare to run wild here. At most, they would attack places of incense outside the Buddhist kingdom.
They never thought about it.
Someone dares to hit Lingshan!
But at this moment, looking at those two figures, their faces instantly turned the color of pig liver.
The slap in the face came so quickly!
And he was slapped twice in the face, each time hurting more than the last!
Lord Buddha's chest rose and fell slightly, and he was extremely angry. He immediately shouted: "The remnants of Tongtian Mountain dare to show up here regardless of life or death. Then don't leave. Let's mobilize the holy soldiers together to keep them here completely."
Following his order.
With a shake of his hand, an alms bowl flew out.
This is another holy weapon.
Not only that, there were two other terrifying old monks with holy light blooming in their hands, activating two other holy weapons.
Suddenly, including the Subduing Demonic Pestle, a total of four holy weapons were used, plus the Holy Dao Formation.
What a pity.
They are too slow.
Above the sky, Wei Laodao and Li Wangshui had already combined the Four Swords of Zhu Xian and the Zhu Xian Diagram into one, and unleashed the most terrifying laws of the Holy Way. Taking advantage of the gap between the three holy weapons of the Buddha Kingdom that had not yet revived, they directly struck the most terrifying blow.
The Zhuxian Diagram shook and erupted with hundreds of millions of rays of light, causing the sacred power of the Four Swords of Zhuxian beneath it to reach the most terrifying level.
"Chi!"
The four swords merged into one, like the supreme sword light that created the world, and struck heavily on the Holy Dao Formation.
Then he made a sound that frightened all the people in the Buddhist country.
"Crack!"
With a crisp sound, the Holy Dao Formation trembled for two breaths and then exploded, being pierced by the Four Swords of Zhu Xian.
After breaking through the sacred guardian formation, they collided heavily with the Demon-Conquering Pestle. With the mighty power of the Holy Spirit, the Demon-Conquering Pestle flew out and smashed into a floating island, causing it to explode.
At the same time, the remaining power of the four swords continued to slash across, rushing towards the main hall at the core of Lingshan.
After continuously breaking through the Holy Dao Formation and the Demon-Subduing Pestle, the Holy Power of the Four Swords has been obliterated a lot, but it is still no problem to destroy a hall.
The holy soldiers in the hands of Lord Buddha and others have not yet recovered and cannot block this sword at all. It is already very difficult to protect the other strong men from the Buddha Kingdom around them.
"Boom!"
Without any surprise, the main hall exploded, and the Buddha's light shone everywhere.
Almost in just a moment, the hall was reduced to ashes by a sword.
"Ahhh!"
"The remnants of Tongtian Mountain, I will kill you!"
With a monstrous roar, the five holy weapons revived and erupted with a terrifying aura that overpowered everything.
"Hahaha, bald donkey of the West, I'm just here to pay off my debt. Remember what we said, if you dare to touch a hair of Lin Yu again, your entire spiritual mountain will be overturned next time."
Li Wangshui's arrogant laughter rang out.
"If you have the ability, you Lingshan will keep the holy soldiers in a state of recovery every day, otherwise I will come again."
After letting go of the harsh words.
The four swords of Zhu Xian turned into light and disappeared in an instant with the two of them.
Li Wangshui and Weird Old Dao were not reckless people. After unexpectedly hitting the strongest Holy Dao attack, they ran away.
Otherwise, if the sleeping ancient Buddha in the depths of Lingshan is really awakened, it will be troublesome, and a real holy Buddha might be awakened.
